name: pathoai-monorepo
description: PathoAI - Clinical AI Decision-Support System: Nodal Metastasis Risk Prediction (MIL)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k --pad-prefix -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI_SERVICE" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && python -m pip install -r ai_service/requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
